description: Open the spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/sensory_raw_notes.xlsx containing messy incident notes from a parent tracking their child's sensory processing challenges. Transform this raw data into a structured analysis for an occupational therapist appointment. Create a new spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/sensory_analysis_for_OT.xlsx with: (1) Cleaned incident log with standardized dates, numeric severity (1-10), trigger categories (Auditory/Tactile/Visual/Olfactory/Multi-sensory), location types, and intervention success flags. (2) Trigger frequency analysis showing count and average severity by trigger type. (3) Time-of-day pattern analysis (Morning/Midday/Afternoon/Evening). (4) Highlight incidents with severity ≥7. Use formulas for calculations. Save the analysis file (Ctrl+S).
